title: Ring Founder Bets AI Will Transform Home Security
text: Ring founder Jamie Siminoff discusses the company’s expansion beyond its signature video doorbell into a broader smart-home security ecosystem, including its new smart lock. He weighs in on growing competition as Apple prepares to enter the category and explains why he sees cameras, locks and other connected devices becoming the physical “appendages” of increasingly powerful AI systems inside the home. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
